full_prompt_en: The image is a horizontal painted scene displayed inside the selected square panel with broad black bands above and below. Two orange-red ceremonial boats face one another on a dark blue-black river. Each carries two standing figures in warm red and ocher garments. Their bodies are flattened and shown mainly in profile, with small raised hands and carefully marked collars, sashes, and head ornaments. The boats have curling swanlike prows. At the center, the two long necks curve inward toward a small red lotus flower rising from the water. Dark wavy lines make a dense horizontal river band beneath them. Along the lower edge, a border of orange blossoms, leaves, and upright grasses repeats across the frame. Above the boats, a scalloped red curtainlike band hangs from the top of the painted scene. Small eye-shaped motifs, flowers, and curls scatter across the deep background. The arrangement is nearly symmetrical, but gestures, boat details, and vegetation differ subtly on either side. Colors are restricted to burnt orange, rust red, muted gold, olive, and very dark blue-black. Fine cream and gold outlines trace the figures, boats, textiles, flowers, and water waves. Every area is decorated, yet the bold twin boats and central lotus remain easy to recognize. Lighting is even and emblematic rather than naturalistic; no sun, cast shadow, or distant perspective is indicated. The picture reads as a flat narrative frieze, with top scallops, middle figures, lower waves, and bottom plants forming stacked horizontal bands. Its visual character lies in the tight ornamental detail, warm-on-dark contrast, mirrored rhythm, and hand-painted surface that remains slightly irregular within its formal structure.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅横向绘制的场景，在所选方形图格中上下有宽黑带。两艘橙红色礼仪船在深蓝黑河上相向，每艘载着两名身穿暖红与赭色服装的站立人物。身体扁平，主要以侧面呈现，手小而抬起，衣领、腰带和头饰被细致标出。船首像弯曲的天鹅。中央，两条长颈朝从水中升起的小红莲弯去。深色波浪线在船下组成密集横向水带。沿下边，橙花、叶和直立草组成重复边饰。船上方，一条扇贝状红帘带从绘画场景顶端垂下。小眼形、花与卷纹散在深色背景中。布局近乎对称，两侧手势、船细节和植物又有细小差异。颜色限制为焦橙、锈红、暗金、橄榄与极深蓝黑。细奶油和金线描出人物、船、织物、花和水波。每处都被装饰，醒目的双船与中央莲花仍容易辨认。光均匀且象征化，没有太阳、投影或远方透视。画面像扁平叙事横饰带：上方扇贝纹、中部人物、下方浪与底部植物组成层叠横带。视觉性格在于紧密纹饰细节、暖色压在深底上的对照、镜像节奏和正式结构内仍略不规则的手绘表面。
style_prompt_en: Ornamental narrative painting organizes flattened forms in stacked horizontal bands. Near-mirrored pairs establish rhythm around a small central emblem, with hand-drawn variations preventing rigidity. Burnt orange, rust, muted gold, olive, and near-black create warm-on-dark contrast. Fine pale outlines describe textiles, flowers, waves, curls, and repeated small motifs. Borders and scalloped bands frame the scene as a decorated frieze. Space remains intentionally shallow, with scale and placement serving pattern more than perspective. Even emblematic illumination leaves no realistic cast shadow. The effect is ceremonial, densely detailed, and tactile, with formal symmetry enlivened by intricate irregular linework.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性叙事绘画将扁平形体组织为层叠横带。近镜像的成对布局围绕小中央标记建立节奏，手绘差异避免僵硬。焦橙、锈、暗金、橄榄与近黑形成暖色压深底的对照。细浅轮廓描绘织物、花、水波、卷曲与重复小图案。边框和扇贝带将场景框成装饰横饰。空间有意浅，尺度和摆放服务于图案多于透视。均匀象征光不留下写实投影。效果仪式化、细节密且可触，正式对称由繁复而不规则的线工活化。
theme_en: Two ornate boats with paired figures facing across a lotus on dark water
theme_zh: 两艘饰纹船载着成对人物，在深水上隔莲花相向
name: Patachitra painting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
